# Ideomint & Ideofest

> Ideomint is a premier creative experience company. Ideofest is Ideomint's flagship live events and ticketing platform in Sri Lanka.

## Key Information
- **Website**: https://ideomint.com
- **Ideofest Platform**: https://ideomint.com/ideofest
- **Admin Portal**: https://ideofest.ideomint.com
- **Location**: Sri Lanka
- **Currency**: LKR (Sri Lankan Rupee)

## Key Features & Offerings
- **Live Event Ticketing**: Premium live concerts, tech summits, creative festivals, workshops, and nightlife experiences in Sri Lanka.
- **Instant QR Tickets**: Encrypted, tamper-proof QR code tickets issued instantly upon booking.
- **Flexible Payments**: Support for PayHere online card payments and direct Sri Lankan bank transfers.
- **Event Management**: Complete organizer dashboard for live check-ins, attendee management, and real-time sales reporting.

## Popular Event Categories
- Music & Concerts
- Tech & Innovation Summits
- Art & Cultural Exhibitions
- Creative Workshops & Masterclasses
- Nightlife & Festival Experiences

## Contact & Support
- **Support Email**: support@ideomint.com
- **Official Domain**: https://ideomint.com
